name: variable-font-morph
title: Variable font morph
author: Eduardo Retana
description: Display text whose variable-font axis follows the scroll: @property registers a number, view() animates it, font-variation-settings reads it. No layout shift. Pure CSS.

meta.descriptionEs: Texto display cuyo eje de fuente variable sigue el scroll: @property registra un número, view() lo anima y font-variation-settings lo lee. Sin desplazar el layout. CSS puro.

examples.title: Del barro al horno
examples.description: Eje wght de Geist, de 100 a 900.

meta.usage: <VariableFontMorph as="h2" text="Del barro al horno" axis="wght" from={100} to={900} />

api.name: text / as
api.description: The display line and its tag.

api.name: axis / from / to / range
api.description: Four-letter axis of the host font (default wght), start and end values, and the view() range (default cover 10% cover 60%). Without motion the text rests at to.

api.name: reserve
api.description: Invisible copy at the widest value reserves the box so the morph causes no layout shift. Turn off only for an axis that keeps glyph advances, such as ELSH.

api.name: loading / error / labels / motion
api.description: Skeleton, alert, copy, and a still mode.

docs: Idea from Midudev's scroll-driven animations demo (reel, 2026). Technical reference: MDN, CSS scroll-driven animations. Implementation is Retana UI's own; no code from the reel. Pure CSS with a local <style>: no JavaScript, no client boundary, safe in a Server Component. The animation sits inside @media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference) and @supports (animation-timeline: …), and animation-timeline comes after the animation shorthand. Without support or with reduced motion the content is visible and still. Pass motion="off" to hold it still from a toggle. Baseline 2026 newly available (27 Oct 2026): Chrome and Edge 115+, Safari 26+, Firefox 159+. The item ships no theme, cssVars, or fixed colors. Loading and error are host states: the piece renders a skeleton or an alert. The host loads the font. Any variable font works: wght on the host's sans, or ELSH on Geist Pixel (SIL OFL-1.1, Copyright 2024 The Geist Project Authors; ship its license with the font file). This item does not bundle a font. The keyframes animate a registered number (--retana-font-morph); font-variation-settings repaints text each frame, so keep one morph per viewport.
